lead: Younus Khan is a widely followed Australian cricketer, born on 29 November 1977 in Mardan.
As of 2026, he is 48 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented Pakistan national cricket team and Peshawar cricket team and has been recognised with Pride of Performance and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
The sections that follow break down Younus Khan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
